papers.title_en: Rethinking Underwater Image Enhancement: Learning through Text-Guided Degradation Curriculum
papers.authors: Hongri Tian, Wenxue Li, Tian Ye, Sixiang Chen, Zongxian Su, Lujia Wang, Xianying Wang, Xinhu Zheng, Gang Hua, Lei Zhu
papers.evidence: 文本引导扩散退化课程的水下图像增强
papers.tldr: 现有配对水下干净-退化数据规模有限且获取困难，难以充分覆盖真实环境中的多样退化，导致增强模型泛化受限。论文提出统一退化感知训练框架：用文本引导扩散模型合成多样且语义一致的退化样本，并以渐进退化课程组织多属性、多难度训练，配合传输引导一步扩散模型完成增强。多个水下基准实验表明该方法取得更优性能。其贡献在于通过可控退化建模与课程学习提升真实场景下的增强鲁棒性。
papers.abstract_en: Existing paired clean-degraded datasets have advanced learning-based underwater image enhancement, but they remain either limited in scale or difficult to acquire, and still fail to adequately cover the diverse degradations encountered in real-world underwater environments. Such scarce and insufficient data ultimately restrict the generalization of underwater image enhancement models, highlighting the need for realistic and controllable degradation modeling to better capture real underwater conditions and improve enhancement robustness. To this end, we propose a unified degradation-aware training framework for the underwater image enhancement task. A Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline uses a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent degraded samples, providing paired data to support the subsequent curriculum learning strategy. The proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum organizes training across multiple attributes and difficulty levels to promote balanced learning, and a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model leverages this progressive process to better address the wide range of degradation severity and restoration ambiguity in underwater images. Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance. Our code and models will be released upon the publication of this work.

papers.title_en: Training-free Acceleration for Blind Compressed Image Restoration via Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition
papers.authors: Suhang Yao, Xin Li, Xijun Wang, Yufei Wang, Yeying Jin, Zhibo Chen
papers.evidence: 基于激活校准SVD的盲压缩图像恢复加速
papers.tldr: 针对Transformer盲压缩图像复原模型投影算子密集、部署成本高的问题，提出无需训练且不改变推理图的激活校准奇异值分解ASVD。方法离线利用预训练权重与少量压缩校准图的通道激活统计，对注意力、前馈、卷积和提示条件路径中的重复投影做低秩替换。在PromptCIR rank 64上，ASVD在四个基准上稳定优于TSVD，参数降59%、计算降16.1%。该工作为盲CIR提供了可即插即用的加速方案。
papers.abstract_en: Transformer-based models achieve strong performance on blind compressed image restoration (CIR) under unknown compression settings, but their densely stacked projection operators make deployment costly. We study training-free acceleration for such models through an empirical, operator-level analysis. Specifically, we profile where computation is concentrated, characterize channel-wise activation distributions under compressed inputs, and examine the singular-value decay of representative projection weights. These measurements identify the recurring projections in the attention, feed-forward, convolutional, and prompt-conditioning pathways as effective low-rank replacement targets that preserve the original inference graph. They further establish truncated SVD (TSVD) as a principled training-free baseline for blind CIR and reveal why a uniform low-rank objective is mismatched to the channel-imbalanced feature distributions of compressed images. Accordingly, we formulate Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition (ASVD) for this restoration setting, deriving low-rank factors entirely offline from pretrained weights and lightweight activation statistics gathered from only a few compressed calibration images. By weighting the decomposition with channel-wise activation magnitudes, our ASVD assigns larger penalties to errors on more active channels, requiring neither retraining nor online calibration and leaving the restoration pipeline intact. When instantiated on PromptCIR at rank 64, ASVD consistently improves PSNR-B over TSVD across four standard benchmarks under identical parameter and MAC budgets. At this operating point, the factorized model cuts parameters by 59% (34.75M to 14.34M) and computation by 16.1% (258.79 to 217.16 GMACs for a 256 x 256 input), enabling acceleration without retraining.

papers.title_en: GLOW-FM: Efficient Generative Low-Light Image Enhancement with One-Step Latent Flow Matching
papers.authors: Ariel Lapid, Yuval Haitman, Reuven Peretz, Arnon Netzer, Idit Diamant
papers.evidence: 基于流匹配的生成式低光图像增强
papers.tldr: 低光照图像增强需从严重退化观测中恢复曝光与感知质量，扩散式生成方法虽质量强但迭代采样成本高。GLOW-FM 在冻结 Tiny-VAE 潜空间进行条件传输，并用终端速度匹配 TVM 实现单次函数评估的生成式增强。在真实基准上，它取得有竞争力画质和领先跨数据集泛化，小模型仅需 34 GFLOPs。该工作以紧凑潜空间和单步推理降低计算门槛，使生成式低光增强更接近实用部署。
papers.abstract_en: Low-light image enhancement (LLIE) aims to recover well-exposed and perceptually faithful images from severely degraded observations. Recent diffusion-based generative methods achieve strong perceptual quality by leveraging powerful image priors, but their iterative sampling incurs substantial computational cost, limiting practical deployment. Despite recent efficiency gains in generative LLIE, high-quality enhancement with a single function evaluation and low overall computation remains challenging, particularly under diverse real-world low-light conditions. We introduce GLOW-FM, a one-step latent flow-matching framework for efficient generative LLIE. GLOW-FM performs conditional transport in the latent space of a frozen Tiny-VAE and leverages Terminal Velocity Matching (TVM) to enable enhancement with a single function evaluation. Matched comparisons with alternative one-step objectives support TVM as an effective design choice, and, to the best of our knowledge, this is its first adaptation to image restoration and specifically to LLIE. Extensive experiments on challenging real-world benchmarks demonstrate that GLOW-FM achieves competitive image quality and state-of-the-art cross-dataset generalization while requiring only a single function evaluation and 34 GFLOPs for the small variant. These findings highlight the potential of GLOW-FM to bring generative LLIE closer to practical deployment through single-step inference and compact latent modeling. Code will be made publicly available upon publication.

papers.title_en: Image Modeling: From Handcrafted Priors to Foundation Image Models
papers.evidence: 以贝叶斯先验框架统一从手工先验到基础模型的图像修复与生成
papers.tldr: 本文回顾图像建模六十年演进，将Tikhonov、TV、非局部先验与PnP、扩散模型统一到贝叶斯框架下，以先验概率p(x)及其对数梯度/Stein score刻画真实图像流形。该视角把图像逆问题与条件生成视为同一数学引擎，连接信号处理与机器学习两条脉络。由此表明，从手工解析先验到大数据基础模型，去噪得分是贯穿MAP优化与后验采样的共同主线。
papers.abstract_en: This paper unifies six decades of image modeling, evolving from handcrafted mathematical tractable priors to solve inverse problems in imaging to data-driven deep foundation image models for both image generation and solving inverse problems, under a common Bayesian framework that formulates image modeling as an implicit or explicit probabilistic characterization of a data manifold. Every image restoration or generative task fundamentally seeks to answer the same question: What makes an image look like a real image? In the Bayesian framework, this question is encapsulated by the prior probability density p(x), or its more optimization-friendly counterpart, the log-prior log p(x). While early works in solving inverse problems, such as Tikhonov, Total Variation (TV), and Non-local priors relied on explicit handcrafted definitions of log prior to model local smoothness, modern techniques, such as Plug-and-Play (PnP) priors and Denoising Diffusion models, are rooted in algorithmic uncoupling and implicit manifold learning that apply to both inverse problems and conditional image generation. By grounding imaging inverse problems and conditional image generation under a single mathematical engine: the gradient of the log-prior, or the Stein Score Function, we bridge the gap between signal processing and machine learning communities, turning what seems like parallel developments into a single, evolution of image modeling from handcrafted analytical models to models learned from big data, demonstrating that the pursuit of the denoising score is the common thread connecting variational optimization (in MAP estimation) to posterior sampling (in modern foundation image models).

papers.title_en: Taming Noise Initialization for Zero-shot Video Restoration with Image Diffusion Priors
papers.authors: Chong Wang, Zixuan Fu, Hao Cheng, Siyuan Yang, Alex C. Kot, Bihan Wen
papers.evidence: 利用图像扩散先验的零样本视频修复
papers.tldr: 视频恢复若依赖视频扩散预训练，计算成本高昂，现有零样本方法用独立或相同高斯噪声初始化，难以利用退化帧间的时间相关性。本文提出驯化噪声初始化：对受损视频帧执行DDIM反演生成初始噪声，并用自适应噪声混合抑制退化模式、逐步逼近高斯分布。同时引入测量引导的轨迹注意力增强跨帧特征对齐。在DAVIS、REDS4和Set8上，该方法在多项视频恢复任务中优于现有零样本方案，为复用图像扩散先验提供了更有效的时序建模路径。
papers.abstract_en: Recent advances in diffusion models have achieved remarkable success in restoring high-quality images in a zero-shot manner. Unfortunately, extending this success to video restoration is challenging due to the substantial computational resources required to pre-train video diffusion models. A rising trend seeks to address video restoration by utilizing a pre-trained image diffusion model, initiating restoration from either frame-wise independent or identical Gaussian noise. Yet, these approaches often fall short, as such simple noise initiations fail to capture and utilize the inherent temporal correlations within degraded video frames. In this work, we propose taming noise initialization for zero-shot video restoration, which preserves the intrinsic temporal correlations by generating initial noises directly using DDIM inversion on the corrupted video frames themselves. Building on this, we introduce an adaptive noise blending strategy that suppresses degradation patterns encoded during DDIM inversion while gradually steering the noise toward a Gaussian distribution. To further emphasize temporal consistency, we propose measurement-guided trajectory attention to better align features across frames. Extensive experiments on multiple video restoration tasks demonstrate that our method outperforms existing zero-shot approaches, consistently achieving superior results on the DAVIS, REDS4, and Set8 datasets.

papers.title_en: MoDDiT: Simple Token Routing in Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Jarek Liesen, Matthew T. Jackson, Benjamin Ellis, Shimon Whiteson, Jakob N. Foerster
papers.evidence: 面向高效图像合成的扩散Transformer令牌路由
papers.tldr: 扩散Transformer生成质量高但计算吞吐受限，且自然图像大量背景使token存在冗余。MoDDiT以简单架构改动让token在MLP与自注意力中独立路由，实现随token、图像和时间步变化的动态计算分配。从头训练图像模型时仅处理低至12.5%的token即可显著降低训练与推理成本，提高稀疏度和深度还能改善生成效果。该方法还可用于视频生成并将稠密双向模型蒸馏为稀疏自回归学生。
papers.abstract_en: Real-time video generation, interactive world models, and on-device image synthesis are almost a reality. Diffusion Transformers (DiT) achieve excellent sample quality, shifting the bottleneck to the throughput of the models themselves. Natural images are inherently sparse, as large portions of an image are often background, contribute little to the scene content, and are easy to denoise. DiTs fail to exploit this sparsity, as they process image tokens statically and uniformly. We propose MoDDiT, a simple architecture modification that learns to route tokens through both MLP and self-attention operations. By routing tokens through both blocks independently, MoDDiT allows for dynamic compute allocation in MLPs that varies across tokens, images, and denoising timesteps. Using MoDDiT to train image generation models from scratch significantly reduces computational costs of training and inference, processing as few as 12.5% of the tokens. By increasing sparsity and model depth, MoDDiT reduces costs and improves generation performance over unrouted baselines. The learned allocation is interpretable, revealing how computation varies with visual content and noise level. We also use MoDDiT to train video generation models, where allocation correlates with motion, and to distill a dense bidirectional video model into a sparse autoregressive student.

papers.title_en: BiNar: Bitstream Native Restorer for Bitstream-corrupted Image Restoration
papers.authors: Fangcheng Li, Zhen Yu, Kejun Wu, Tianyi Liu
papers.evidence: 面向码流损坏图像修复的生成式修复框架
papers.tldr: 针对压缩码流损坏导致误差传播、像素失真甚至无法解码的问题，提出生成式修复框架BiNar，直接从受损码流提取细粒度语义。它用BSeM建模字节语义，结合CMSA聚合多模态线索，并由BCoL定位错误区域作为扩散模型提示。多类码流损坏实验表明其在感知与客观质量上均优于现有方法，凸显码流原生语义对BCIR的价值。
papers.abstract_en: Bitstream-corrupted image restoration (BCIR) aims to reconstruct faithful images from corrupted compressed bitstreams. However, corruption occurs in bitstream-domain may lead to unpredictable error propagation and distortion amplification in pixel-domain, and even result in complete undecodability by standard decoders, posing significant challenge to existing image restoration paradigms. To address this challenge, we propose Bitstream Native Restorer (BiNar), a generative restoration framework that leverages fine-grained bitstream-native semantics to guide bitstream-corrupted image restoration. In BiNar, Bitstream Semantic Modeling (BSeM) extracts robust informative semantics and models sequential bytes directly from corrupted bitstream, enabling to generate fine-grained bitstream descriptions without relying on pixel decoding. Based on the descriptions,the Corruption-adaptive Multimodal Semantic Aggregation (CMSA) further extracts adaptive visual modal cues in decoded corrupted images and aggregates to bitstream descriptions. The multimodal aggregated fine-grained descriptions can serve as coherent restoration guidance. Finally, Blind Corruption Localization (BCoL) exploits the segmentation prior of visual foundation models to identify and locate error regions that requires recovery in corrupted images. The located error regions and the fine-grained descriptions jointly serve as visual prompt and language prompt of diffusion models image restoration, respectively. Extensive experiments under diverse bitstream corruption conditions show that BiNar outperforms all State-of-the-arts image restoration models regardless of perceptual quality or objective quality. Ablation studies demonstrate the effectiveness of fine-grained bitstream-native semantics in BCIR task.

papers.title_en: Editing Images into Reusable Layers via Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation
papers.authors: Wen Xue, Yong Liu, Xueheng Li, Si Wu, Yong Xu, Yipeng Sun, Yan Li, Simiu Gu
papers.evidence: 指令引导的图像编辑生成可复用图层
papers.tldr: 现有图像编辑多输出扁平结果，难以局部精修和图层复用，而分解方法常与指令编辑分离优化。LayerEditor将指令引导编辑与可控生成可复用RGBA图层统一，通过上下文RGB-Alpha token建模在单一序列中联合表示编辑画布和有序图层。其组合编辑先验蒸馏把预训练编辑先验迁移到编辑画布及图层合成图，并构建LayerEditor-100K与分层编辑基准。实验显示其在保持编辑保真度的同时生成准确RGBA层，支持灵活图层操作与多层分解。
papers.abstract_en: High-quality image editing requires precise modification of target regions while preserving the content of unrelated regions. Existing editing models produce flattened outputs that limit precise local manipulation and layer reuse, while decomposition methods typically optimize layer recovery separately from instruction-driven editing. To this end, we introduce LayerEditor, a unified framework that couples instruction-guided image editing with controllable generation of reusable RGBA layers. At its core, In-Context RGB-Alpha Token Modeling jointly represents the edited canvas and an ordered sequence of RGB-Alpha layers within a single token sequence, enabling semantic edits and explicit control over individual layer content. To retain the pretrained model's editing capability during adaptation to layered outputs, we propose Compositional Edit-Prior Distillation, which transfers its editing prior to both the edited canvas and the image composed from the predicted layers. To support training and evaluation, we construct LayerEditor-100K, a large-scale paired image-editing dataset with ordered RGBA layer annotations, and introduce dedicated benchmarks for layered editing. Extensive experiments demonstrate that LayerEditor maintains strong editing fidelity while generating accurate RGBA layers, supporting both flexible layer-level manipulation and multi-layer decomposition.

papers.title_en: Continual Concept Personalization in Diffusion Models via Residual-Space Adaptation
papers.authors: Yuzhi Liu, Enis Simsar, Giulia Lanzillotta, Thomas Hofmann
papers.evidence: 预训练扩散模型中的持续概念个性化
papers.tldr: 文本到图像扩散模型个性化通常独立训练概念或假设概念同时可用，难以应对概念顺序到达。本文把残差空间适应扩展到预训练扩散模型的随机适应过程，实现持续概念个性化。方法在竞争方法中取得最高概念保真度且遗忘接近零，并借残差空间动态定位关键层。仅适应这些层可保持近乎相同性能，同时将可训练参数最多减少72%，为参数高效持续个性化提供依据。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image personalization aims to equip pretrained diffusion models with the ability to learn user-specific concepts from only a few reference images. Existing methods, however, typically train each concept independently or assume that all concepts are available simultaneously. In practical applications, concepts often arrive sequentially, requiring models to continually learn new subjects, objects, or styles while minimizing interference with previously acquired concepts. We address this continual concept personalization setting by extending residual-space adaptation to the stochastic adaptation process of pretrained diffusion models. Our work achieves the highest concept fidelity among competing continual personalization methods while maintaining near-zero forgetting. Beyond these empirical gains, the learned residual-space dynamics reveal where adaptation capacity is concentrated within the diffusion model. Restricting adaptation to the identified layers by our method preserves nearly the same performance while reducing the number of trainable parameters by up to 72\%, demonstrating that residual-space dynamics can identify the layers that contribute most to continual concept personalization and directly guide more parameter-efficient adaptation.

papers.title_en: GWDM: A Guided Wavelet Diffusion Model for Realistic Histopathology Image Generation
papers.authors: Abdullah, Tao Huang, Ickjai Lee, Lei Bi, Euijoon Ahn
papers.evidence: 用于组织病理图像生成的引导小波扩散模型
papers.tldr: 病理图像标注稀缺制约深度学习诊断，现有生成模型将组织切片视作自然图像，缺少组织形态与染色约束。本文提出引导小波扩散模型GWDM，用多尺度小波捕捉细节，以组织模式和颜色变化等域特征作可控条件，并引入组织形态引导损失与损失渐入策略稳定训练。在BCSS、MoNuSeg、PAIP2019上优于先进生成方法，消融验证各组件有效。合成数据增强真实训练集后，下游细胞核与组织分割持续提升，显示其缓解数据稀缺的临床价值。
papers.abstract_en: Histopathology images are recognized as a reliable and comprehensive modality for Deep Learning (DL) based diagnosis. However, effectiveness is constrained by limited large-scale annotated datasets, as collecting expert-labeled medical data is costly and time-intensive. Recent advances in generative models, particularly diffusion models, demonstrate strong capabilities in synthesizing medically relevant content for dataset augmentation. Existing generative frameworks treat histopathology patches as generic natural images, failing to enforce biological constraints such as histomorphological structures and heterogeneous staining patterns essential for valid synthesis. We propose a guided wavelet diffusion model (GWDM) framework that captures image details at multiple scales using wavelets and leverages controllable conditioning based on domain-specific histopathological features (e.g., tissue patterns and color variations). We further formulate a histomorphological guidance loss applied to real and generated patches. A loss ramping strategy gradually introduces these constraints during training, ensuring stable optimization and robust modeling of tissue architecture. GWDM was evaluated on three benchmark datasets (BCSS, MoNuSeg, and PAIP2019), consistently outperforming state-of-the-art generative methods. Ablation studies confirmed that domain-guided conditioning, perceptual loss, and structural similarity loss each contribute meaningfully to synthesis quality. Downstream nuclei and tissue segmentation experiments further validated the clinical utility of GWDM-generated images, demonstrating consistent performance improvements when synthetic data augments real training sets. This work shows that domain-specific conditioning and dual-loss optimization generate realistic histopathology patches, reducing data scarcity and improving clinical downstream segmentation performance.

papers.title_en: Real In, Real Out: What If We Only Use Real Data for Scene Text Editing?
papers.authors: Xingsong Ye, Yongkun Du, Jiaxin Zhang, Chong Sun, Zhineng Chen
papers.evidence: 利用真实数据自配对监督的场景文本编辑
papers.tldr: 场景文本编辑通常依赖合成配对数据和复杂解耦策略，难以忠实还原自然场景的多样性，常出现伪影或幻觉。本文提出只用真实数据的TextRIRO：把每张真实图像作为自身配对监督，通过字符列打乱与图像裁剪破坏文本语义但保留风格线索，并基于条件扩散架构学习编辑行为。实验表明其在真实基准上兼顾编辑准确性与视觉真实感，显著缓解合成到真实的域差距。作者进一步构建TextRIRO-3M并验证其能提升长文本识别，拓展了STE的实用价值。
papers.abstract_en: Aiming to modify textual content while preserving the original style, Scene Text Editing (STE) has significant practical value in many applications. STE typically requires paired images before and after editing for training. However, recent approaches rely heavily on synthetic paired data and complex disentanglement strategies. They struggle to faithfully capture the diversity and complexity of natural scenes, often producing artifacts or hallucinations. In this work, we challenge the common practice and investigate whether STE can be driven by turning each real sample into its own paired supervision. Concretely, we explore multiple ways to disrupt the original image (e.g., Crop, Shuffle, Mask) to construct self-paired training data, and build a strong baseline (TextRIRO}) upon a conditional diffusion architecture. Our experiments show that combining character-column shuffling with image cropping (Shuffle&Crop) effectively destroys text semantics while preserving key style cues, enabling the model to learn editing behaviors directly from the real text image. With this concise yet real-oriented design, TextRIRO achieves promising performance in both accuracy and visual realism across real-world benchmarks, substantially mitigating the synthetic-to-real domain gap. Furthermore, we leverage TextRIRO to build TextRIRO-3M, a large-scale realistic dataset for long-text recognition by concatenating edited and original images. Experimental results show that training recognition models with TextRIRO-3M significantly improves recognition accuracy, demonstrating that TextRIRO provides highly useful training resources for downstream tasks. Overall, TextRIRO lifts STE to realistic, reliable, and widely applicable new levels. Code is available at https://github.com/YesianRohn/TextRIRO.

papers.title_en: Unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration via Linear Illumination and Frequency-Adaptive Enhancement
papers.authors: Yingkai Zhang, Yunhao Zou, Ying Fu
papers.evidence: 统一的RAW曝光校正与图像修复
papers.tldr: 现有sRGB曝光校正受非线性ISP限制，RAW方法多只针对低光去噪或高光恢复单一退化。本文提出统一RAW曝光校正与复原框架RIECR，将问题解耦为线性光照校正和残差退化复原：LICN利用通道RAW线索估计曝光感知线性增益，FEN以频域动态卷积恢复噪声与纹理。在223场景、1784对真实RAW基准上，RIECR优于16种先进方法。
papers.abstract_en: Incorrect exposure degrades both image brightness and recoverable scene detail. Existing sRGB-based correction methods are limited by the non-linear image signal processing pipeline, whereas RAW-based methods are usually developed for a single degradation type, such as low-light denoising or high-light recovery. In this paper, we focus on joint exposure correction and restoration directly in the RAW domain and propose a unified RAW Image Exposure Correction and Restoration (RIECR) framework for both under- and over-exposed images. RIECR decomposes the problem into two coupled sub-problems that follow the RAW imaging model: linear illumination correction and residual degradation restoration. First, a Linear Illumination Correction Network (LICN) estimates exposure-aware linear gains by using channel-specific RAW cues. It exploits the high signal-to-noise ratio of Green channels for robust brightening and the relatively unsaturated Red/Blue responses for high-light darkening. Second, a dual-branch Frequency-based Enhancement Network (FEN) restores the remaining degradation with a Frequency Dynamic Convolution (FDC) module. FDC decomposes convolutional responses into low- and high-frequency components and adaptively suppresses amplified noise or recovers clipped textures according to the exposure context. We further build a real paired RAW benchmark containing 223 scenes and 1,784 pairs covering complex multi-exposure errors. Experiments against sixteen state-of-the-art methods show that RIECR achieves state-of-the-art performance on real RAW exposure correction.

papers.title_en: ABACUS: A Benchmark for Image Editing Models to Assess Object Category and Counting Under Scene Conservation
papers.authors: Aymen Lassoued, Angelique Loesch, Romaric Audigier
papers.evidence: 评估图像编辑模型物体类别与计数能力的基准
papers.tldr: 指令式图像编辑模型常能增删指定数量物体或改变类别并保持场景，但数量错误会随场景复杂度和目标计数上升而急剧恶化。现有基准多用整体相似度或计数能力不足的VLM评判，数值错误易被漏判或误判。ABACUS提出免评判基准、协议与专用评分指标，基于全景真值在实例级核验精确数量与场景保持，覆盖增、删、改操作。评测主流编辑器揭示显著数值编辑失败，且随复杂度和数量增加而加剧，弥补了此前测量盲区。
papers.abstract_en: Instruction-based image editing models can now add, remove a specified number of objects or change their category while preserving the scene. Yet these models often fail to produce the correct number, and these failures grow sharply as scenes become more complex and the requested count increases. Current benchmarks largely miss this problem: they score edits with holistic similarity metrics or with vision-language model (VLM) judges that are themselves poor at counting, so numerical errors go unnoticed or are graded incorrectly. As a result, the true numerical ability of today's editing models has never been accurately measured. We address this issue with ABACUS, a new benchmark, evaluation protocol and dedicated scoring metric for numerical image editing. Our protocol is judge-free: no VLM or MLLM scores an edit or counts objects (a VLM only confirms the category of rare ambiguous crops). Instead, it verifies each edit at the instance level against panoptic ground truth confirmed by detector consensus, checking both that the exact requested count was achieved and that the rest of the scene was preserved, across the add, remove and change operations. By evaluating leading image editors, our method reveals substantial numerical editing failures that worsen with increasing scene complexity and object count; failures that prior benchmarks often overlooked or misjudged.

papers.title_en: T-DIG: Text-Conditioned Diversity for Image Generation
papers.authors: Simran Khanuja, Rohit Gandikota, Gaurav Parmar, Graham Neubig
papers.evidence: 面向图像生成与编辑的文本条件多样性框架
papers.tldr: 文本到图像模型常一次返回多图供用户探索，但优化单图质量会牺牲多图多样性，且用户所需变化维度随语境而变。T-DIG用LLM策略为冻结的生成或编辑模型生成K条轴条件提示，并以GRPO和文本条件多样性奖励训练。它在多种指标与人工评估中显著提升文本条件多样性，同时保持基础提示对齐。该框架无需访问模型权重，可推广到开放、蒸馏和闭源模型。
papers.abstract_en: Text-to-image (T2I) platforms typically return several images per prompt so users can explore different visual interpretations and choose one that matches their intent. However, T2I models are usually optimized for single-image quality which comes at a cost of multi-image diversity, limiting this exploration. Diversity is also contextual: one user wants variations in background, while another wants them in artistic style, and the same user may later want variations in clothing. The generated images should differ along whatever axis the user cares about. In this paper, we introduce T-DIG, a text-conditioned diversity framework for image generation and editing. T-DIG is an iterative framework comprising multiple modules that lets users type prompts, inspect default generations, request variations using natural language, and continue refining outputs until they're satisfied. At its core, T-DIG uses an LLM policy that produces K axis-conditioned prompts or edit instructions for a frozen generator or editor. We train this policy with GRPO using a text-conditioned diversity reward and alignment penalties. Because the image generator remains frozen, T-DIG applies to open-weight, distilled, and proprietary models. We also release the first dataset for text-conditioned prompt diversity in image generation, with the training and validation splits built from human-written axes and a test set drawn from real user interactions with T-DIG. T-DIG far exceeds baselines in improving text-conditioned diversity, while preserving base-prompt alignment across a variety of metrics and human judgements. We show that user-directed diversity exploration can be added to a wide range of image generation models, open and closed, without the need to access their weights. Website: https://image-study.org/t-dig/

papers.title_en: HealBench: A Fine-Grained Benchmark for Evaluating Psychological Comfort in Text-to-Image Generation
papers.authors: Junjie Xu, Yuzhe Yang, Rui Yang, Luwei Xiao, Wenxin Wu, Xingjiao Wu, Liang He
papers.evidence: 评估文生图与图像编辑心理舒适度的细粒度基准
papers.tldr: 文本到图像生成在真实感、语义和美学之外，仍缺乏对心理舒适度的评估。作者提出HealBench，含3万高质量图文对、19类92子类，并构建1095例HealBench-Eval评测集。对14个生成模型与提示改写策略评测发现，常规视觉质量与感知舒适度存在明显差距。进一步验证HealScorer可作为强化学习奖励信号，用于评估和提升生成图像的情感与恢复性质量。
papers.abstract_en: Despite advances in photorealism, semantic fidelity, and aesthetics, text-to-image generation and image editing remain understudied in a human-centered dimension: whether their outputs feel psychologically comforting. Grounded in cognitive evaluation theory, we define psychological comfort as an affective response shaped by viewers' appraisal of restorative and emotionally supportive visual cues. We introduce HealBench, a fine-grained benchmark of 30,000 high-quality image-text pairs spanning 19 categories and 92 subcategories, selected from 100,000 candidates through a human- and expert-in-the-loop pipeline combining vision-language model matching, human preference models, expert filtering, and exemplar-guided augmentation. We also construct HealBench-Eval, a feature-clustered evaluation set of 1,095 instances. Using HealBench-Eval, we conduct objective and subjective evaluations of 14 representative image generation models and prompt-rewriting strategies. Results reveal a gap between conventional visual quality and perceived comfort: strong semantic alignment and aesthetics do not guarantee emotionally restorative images. Reinforcement learning experiments further show that HealScorer can serve as a reward signal for assessing and improving the emotional and restorative quality of generated images. These findings establish psychological comfort as a distinct dimension of human-centered image generation and position HealBench as a foundation for affect-aware generative models.

papers.title_en: CityPaint: A Free Lunch from 2D Diffusion for City-Scale 3D Texturing
papers.authors: Yuchen Zou, Lihuang Fang, Siyu Zhu, Xiao Hu
papers.evidence: 利用二维扩散模型进行三维纹理生成
papers.tldr: 城市级3D环境生成受限于真实城市级3D训练数据稀缺，现有方法常拼接独立资产或依赖合成语料，牺牲真实感与全局一致性。CityPaint利用丰富的2D扩散模型先验，结合几何先验与top-K相机烘焙策略迭代投影纹理，并用解耦细化分别优化地形与建筑。实验表明其生成纹理全局连贯、局部细节清晰，在视觉质量与跨视角一致性上优于强基线，为城市级3D纹理提供无需城市级3D训练数据的“免费午餐”。
papers.abstract_en: Generating high-fidelity, city-scale 3D environments plays a crucial role in applications such as virtual reality, gaming, and urban digital twins. However, the scarcity of real-world city-scale 3D training data forces existing methods to either stitch independently generated assets or learn from synthetic urban corpora, often sacrificing realism and global consistency. In contrast, 2D image data and their corresponding generative models are abundant and encode rich visual priors. To bridge this gap, we propose CityPaint, a novel framework that leverages 2D diffusion models to generate globally consistent city-scale 3D textures without relying on city-scale 3D training data. Specifically, CityPaint integrates geometric priors with the generative power of 2D diffusion models, introducing a robust top-$K$ camera baking strategy for iterative texture projection. To address the artifacts of 2D-to-3D projection, we further propose a decoupled refinement mechanism that separately optimizes terrain and building textures. Extensive experiments show that CityPaint produces globally coherent textures with fine local details and achieves favorable results against strong baselines in both visual quality and cross-view consistency.

papers.title_en: JUICE: Unified Multimodal Modeling in Pretrained Representation Spaces
papers.authors: Jiahan Li, Huangyuan Su, Shengbang Tong, Shusheng Yang, Ruihan Guo, Suozhi Huang, Hexu Zhao, Pratyusha Sharma, Sherry Yang, Jiatao Gu, Rob Fergus, Kyunghyun Cho
papers.evidence: 基于流匹配Transformer的统一多模态生成建模
papers.tldr: 现有多模态统一模型常由语言模型出文本、扩散头出图像，顺序固定，首输出难以适应后续。JUICE在冻结图文编码器表示空间上，用单一flow matching Transformer联合建模两模态，并为各模态设独立噪声水平；干净/生成模态组合决定图像生成、描述、VQA或联合生成。2.1B参数、无语言模型初始化下，GenEval达0.88、VQAv2达73.1，联合采样在地图路径与文字指令任务上显著优于独立采样。
papers.abstract_en: Most unified multimodal models treat images and text asymmetrically: a pretrained language model generates text, an attached diffusion head generates images, and outputs that contain both are produced in a fixed order, so the first output cannot adapt to the second. We ask whether both modalities can instead be generated by one process that is trained on them jointly from scratch. Pretrained encoder spaces hold both modalities in one continuous form and carry knowledge learned at scale, and recent work finds them effective as generative targets for vision and language. We therefore model the joint distribution directly in these spaces. We introduce JUICE (Joint Unified multimodal modeling In Continuous Encoder spaces), a single flow matching Transformer over frozen image and text representations, in which each modality has its own noise level. Which modalities are clean and which are generated then decides the task: image generation, captioning, visual question answering, or joint generation. Controlled pretraining runs test each design choice. At equal guidance, generating text as continuous states leaves image generation intact (48.41 GenEval, against 47.86 for a model trained only for text-to-image generation), while captions lose some exact wording. Training on joint and conditional denoising together beats either alone, and semantic encoder spaces beat VAE latents and raw pixels as targets. At 2.1B parameters, with no language model initialization and at 224x224, JUICE reaches up to 0.88 on GenEval and 73.1 on VQAv2. By sampling both modalities from the joint distribution (coupled sampling), it can also draw a route on a map while writing out the matching moves. On mazes with several valid solutions, joint success rises from 54.6% with independent sampling to 93.7%, and no modality has to go first. On visual spatial planning, JUICE solves 99.8% of maps at its training sizes.
